The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Script review. Same weights as the manager today; separate role so it can move without a code change.

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

senior.name: Senior

The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Script review. Same weights as the manager today; separate role so it can move without a code change.

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

senior.name: Senior

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. Q4 weights today; the real Senior is still undecided (staffing run: laguna-xs.2 scored 3/5). Swap the tag here; the endpoint and lease stay.
senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

claude.name: Claude
claude.what: Claude Code. The gate: merges delivered builds (D-34), verifies done-checks, takes what is assigned to it.

jas.name: Jas
jas.what: Answers what is assigned to him on the Review tab: assign, unassign, or change who it is assigned to.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

before._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
before._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

before._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

senior.name: Senior

The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Script review. Same weights as the manager today; separate role so it can move without a code change.

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. Q4 weights today; the real Senior is still undecided (staffing run: laguna-xs.2 scored 3/5). Swap the tag here; the endpoint and lease stay.
senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

claude.name: Claude
claude.what: Claude Code. The gate: merges delivered builds (D-34), verifies done-checks, takes what is assigned to it.

jas.name: Jas
jas.what: Answers what is assigned to him on the Review tab: assign, unassign, or change who it is assigned to.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

after._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
after._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Q4 on the ThinkPad eGPU (ollama-thinkpad, 56k context, 100% GPU, 53.8 tok/s; Q4 on the GX10 measured 7.1 only because that Ollama had fallen back to the CPU after a bad restart -- re-bench on its GPU; measurements.jsonl 2026-10-12). Script review, RCA, session review -- the weakly-verified work, off Swift so the GX10 keeps scoping and building (MASTER-PLAN H, 2026-10-12). One lane: Ollama on Windows, one 17.5 GB model in 24 GB.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

before._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
before._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Q4 on the ThinkPad eGPU (ollama-thinkpad, 56k context, 100% GPU, 53.8 tok/s; Q4 on the GX10 measured 7.1 only because that Ollama had fallen back to the CPU after a bad restart -- re-bench on its GPU; measurements.jsonl 2026-10-12). Script review, RCA, session review -- the weakly-verified work, off Swift so the GX10 keeps scoping and building (MASTER-PLAN H, 2026-10-12). One lane: Ollama on Windows, one 17.5 GB model in 24 GB.

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

jas.name: Jas
jas.what: Answers what is assigned to him on the Review tab: assign, unassign, or change who it is assigned to.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

before._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
before._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Q4 on the ThinkPad eGPU (ollama-thinkpad, 56k context, 100% GPU, 53.8 tok/s; Q4 on the GX10 measured 7.1 only because that Ollama had fallen back to the CPU after a bad restart -- re-bench on its GPU; measurements.jsonl 2026-10-12). Script review, RCA, session review -- the weakly-verified work, off Swift so the GX10 keeps scoping and building (MASTER-PLAN H, 2026-10-12). One lane: Ollama on Windows, one 17.5 GB model in 24 GB.

coder.name: Frontline
coder.what: The production build lane. Jas's standing order: builds go to Gemma, Claude merges.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. Q4 weights today; the real Senior is still undecided (staffing run: laguna-xs.2 scored 3/5). Swap the tag here; the endpoint and lease stay.
senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

senior.name: Senior
senior.what: SENIOR BUILDER -- PLACEHOLDER (Jas, 2026-09-28: 'dedicate this to preflight. Lets call it the Senior builder and it will be a place holder until we decide the actual Sr model.'). Runs every preflight review on its own Ollama server (ollama-station2.service), so scoped work reaches the coder without queueing behind session reviews on the main server. Q4 weights today; the real Senior is still undecided (staffing run: laguna-xs.2 scored 3/5). Swap the tag here; the endpoint and lease stay.
senior._what_endpoint: The Ollama server this role's jobs call. Absent or unreachable -> the job runs on the main server (:11434) under the shared lease, exactly as before.

claude.name: Claude
claude.what: Claude Code. The gate: merges delivered builds (D-34), verifies done-checks, takes what is assigned to it.

jas.name: Jas
jas.what: Answers what is assigned to him on the Review tab: assign, unassign, or change who it is assigned to.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

before._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
before._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Q4 on the ThinkPad eGPU (ollama-thinkpad, 56k context, 100% GPU, 53.8 tok/s; Q4 on the GX10 measured 7.1 only because that Ollama had fallen back to the CPU after a bad restart -- re-bench on its GPU; measurements.jsonl 2026-10-12). Script review, RCA, session review -- the weakly-verified work, off Swift so the GX10 keeps scoping and building (MASTER-PLAN H, 2026-10-12). One lane: Ollama on Windows, one 17.5 GB model in 24 GB.

embedder.name: Embedder
embedder.what: memory.py recall and the corpus index. Ollama pins embedding runners to -np 1 regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.what: Used when Claude's usage runs out. No tasks enabled until Jas chooses them; Merge review stays off so it cannot merge by accident.

after._what: The role store (Jas, 2026-09-29): every role -- model, person or agent -- with its model, server, tools, tasks in priority order, and how its calls are set up. Edited through scripts/role_store.py (and the Models tab); SERVING.json's roles block is generated from this.
after._step1: Migrated with NO behaviour change: tools are role_caps.load() as it resolved before; task lists and profile_by_task DESCRIBE today's routing and settings -- the dispatcher does not route by them until step 4; attributes are empty overrides until the Roles pages (step 2).

jas.name: Jas
jas.what: Answers what is assigned to him on the Review tab: assign, unassign, or change who it is assigned to.

claude.name: Claude
claude.what: Claude Code. The gate: merges delivered builds (D-34), verifies done-checks, takes what is assigned to it.

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. The bf16 was NOT re-measured in that run; its figure is the production telemetry median, 8.6 tok/s over 174 rows (measurements.jsonl, 2026-09-25) -- the '6.5' cited here until 2026-09-25 had no measurement behind it. 16.7 GB resident against 54. Same weights as Q16 at lower precision, so Q4 must not review Q16's work either -- that stays with Claude.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.what: Q4 on the ThinkPad eGPU (ollama-thinkpad, 56k context, 100% GPU, 53.8 tok/s; Q4 on the GX10 measured 7.1 only because that Ollama had fallen back to the CPU after a bad restart -- re-bench on its GPU; measurements.jsonl 2026-10-12). Script review, RCA, session review -- the weakly-verified work, off Swift so the GX10 keeps scoping and building (MASTER-PLAN H, 2026-10-12). One lane: Ollama on Windows, one 17.5 GB model in 24 GB.

manager.name: Manager
manager.what: Q4 (Jas, 2026-09-23: 'after the swap Q4 does all of Q16's work'). Supervises, reviews briefs, assigns failure categories, scopes. Measured on a quiet box 2026-09-23: 17.6-20.7 tok/s. auditor.name: Auditor
